description: This Java source file defines an immutable class 'ImmutableFeature' representing a feature within the Ditto framework, including methods for creation, property management, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: ImmutableFeature
classes.description: An immutable class representing a feature with ID, optional definition, and properties, providing methods for modification, JSON serialization, and equality checks.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory methods to create ImmutableFeature instances with various parameters (ID only, ID with properties, ID with definition and properties).

methods.name: setDefinition
methods.description: Returns a new Feature with the specified definition.

methods.name: removeDefinition
methods.description: Returns a new Feature without a definition.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the feature's properties.

methods.name: setProperties
methods.description: Returns a new Feature with the specified properties.

methods.name: removeProperties
methods.description: Returns a new Feature without properties.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a property value at a given JSON pointer path.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a property value at a given JSON pointer path, returning a new Feature.

methods.name: removeProperty
methods.description: Removes a property at a given JSON pointer path, returning a new Feature.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the feature's definition.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the feature to a JSON object according to schema version and predicate.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on feature ID, definition, and properties.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on ID, definition, and properties.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the feature.
